questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Iran?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Iran article.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Iran?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Iran article.

questions.proof: The majority of the population talks Persian (also known as Farsi), yet most of the population also speaks such languages as Azeri, Kurdish, and Luri.
